views.introduction:
This page explains internal query stages and stored evidence. [How to understand a Kast answer](/explanation) introduces the reader concepts.

For public requests, use [Query forms](/reference/api). Contract 19 selects `TRACE` through `terminalStep`, never through `steps`. The internal TRACE stage described here does not change that public request grammar.

Exact reference: [Results](/reference/responses).

Explanations: [Query reuse](/architecture/query-reuse).

Task procedures: [Read retained output](/how-to/read-retained-evidence).

views.frontmatter:
title: "Prepare the managed workspace"
sidebarTitle: "Workspace preparation"
description: "Distinguish explicit workspace preparation from passive session hooks and recorded lifecycle evidence."
icon: "monitor-cog"
hideFooterPagination: true
views.introduction:
The managed-runtime contract starts preparation only for an explicit workspace request. Session hooks and discovery are passive: they do not grant trust or start a Host.

The source-bound excerpts distinguish current managed request admission from retained coordinator and legacy lifecycle owners. They describe source contracts, not completed native qualification or installation instructions. Claims outside this focused refresh can still carry source drift.

Current procedures: [Set up Kast](/start), [Manage Kast](/reference/management).

Recovery: [Help](/troubleshooting).

Explanations: [Lifecycles](/reference/lifecycles).

title: "Symbol identity and source fields"
description: "Use exact compiler references, locations, and signatures without guessing identity."
icon: "braces"
hideFooterPagination: true
views.introduction:
This page explains declaration identity and the source contracts that use it. The shared contracts include source APIs other than `query_symbols`.

For `query_symbols`, `READ_SOURCE.candidateRef` checks the issued snapshot. It does not reacquire a stale exact reference. A fresh `RUN` can reacquire an exact reference after current compiler identity checks. It does not refresh retained rows or source snapshots. [Query forms](/reference/api#actions) defines the current public actions.

Task procedures: [Find and trace code](/reference/search).

Explanations: [Staleness](/reference/staleness).
